items.source:
Assist with configuration for handler method argument resolvers.
At present, it supports only providing a list of custom resolvers.
items.translation: 协助配置处理器方法参数解析器。目前，仅支持提供自定义解析器列表。

items.source: Configure resolvers for custom handler method arguments.
items.translation: 为自定义处理器方法参数配置解析器。
